name: topik-station
description: TOPIK Station — a Korean language learning platform (monorepo runner).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && npm run db:wait
scripts.db:load: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d topik_station < backend/schema.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:load
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:load
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
